items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {inst : Preorder α} [self : LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] (a x : α),
  x ∈ LocallyFiniteOrderBot.finsetIic a ↔ x ≤ a
items.informal_description: In a locally finite order with a bottom element, an element $x$ is in the finite interval $[\bot, a]$ if and only if $x \leq a$.

items.informal_name: Membership in Iic a iff $x \leq a$
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] {a x : α}, x ∈ Finset.Iic a ↔ x ≤ a
items.informal_description: For any element $x$ in a type $\alpha$ equipped with a locally finite order and a bottom element $\bot$, $x$ belongs to the finite set $Iic\, a$ (containing all elements $y$ with $\bot \leq y \leq a$) if and only if $x \leq a$.

items.informal_name: Finite Support Function of Closed Intervals Between Two Functions
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [inst_2 : LocallyFiniteOrder α]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {f g : ι →₀ α} {i : ι} {a : α}, a ∈ (f.rangeIcc g) i ↔ f i ≤ a ∧ a ≤ g i
items.informal_description: The function constructs a finite support function that maps each index $ i $ to the closed interval $[f(i), g(i)]$ in $ \alpha $, with support restricted to indices $ i $ where the interval is non-empty. Here, $ \alpha $ is equipped with a partial order and locally finite order structure, ensuring each interval is finite.
